basic_profile.bio: A tech-savvy enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who loves combining modern technology with traditional hobbies. ShadowHunter_77 works as a software developer by day and is an avid anime fan by night, particularly drawn to the Demon Slayer series. When not coding or binge-watching anime, they enjoy exploring the great outdoors and occasionally go hunting. Typically online during late evenings and weekends, ShadowHunter_77 is happily single and spends much of their free time engaging in online discussions about political science and gaming setups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ShadowHunter_77 has a strong background in computer science with a degree from the University of Texas. Over the years, they have honed their skills in software development through both formal education and self-teaching, staying updated with the latest technological advancements. Their interest in anime and gaming has led them to become knowledgeable about media and entertainment technologies.
